name: solve-trigonometric-problem
description: Solve trigonometric equations and triangle problems systematically using identities, law of sines/cosines, inverse functions, and unit circle analysis. Covers equation solving, triangle resolution, identity verification, and applied trigonometric modeling. Use when solving trigonometric equations for unknown angles, resolving triangles from partial information (SSS, SAS, ASA), verifying identities, or applying trigonometry to real-world problems in surveying, physics, or engineering.
